s3_proven_facts.label: RESULT_PATTERN
s3_proven_facts.detail: Pick SP distribution skews below market mid-price. System over-trusts public strength/RPR signal.

s3_proven_facts.fact: 803 mid-price misses exist — 6–10 odds band is the core wound
s3_proven_facts.label: RESULT_PATTERN
s3_proven_facts.detail: 6–10 = 312 misses (core). 4–6 = 288. 10–16 = 65. Winners at 6–10 SP lost to wrong selection.

s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: Model heavily weighted on RPR and trainer/jockey public form. Creates short-price over-selection.

s3_proven_facts.fact: New Build is VALUE_SCOUT / EXOTIC_FILL_CANDIDATE — not replacement engine
s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: New Build SR=24.2% but only N=1125 prospective rows. 4/4 unseen gates passed. Shadow only until N≥300 top-decile.

s3_proven_facts.fact: EW_CANDIDATE is PLACE_SIGNAL — not profit proof
s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: EW place rate 37.3%. No pick_sp data. Cannot compute EW ROI without prices. VFU-21 required.

s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: Top-3 containment signal exists but no dividend data captured. Cannot proof exotic profit without it.

s3_proven_facts.fact: Course intelligence is missing from VELO scoring
s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: Draw bias, pace map, course-position features are CRITICAL missing features. Not in any live model.

s3_proven_facts.fact: Draw/pace features are critical but not implemented
s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: draw_bias_by_course_distance and pace_map_front_runner_flag are CRITICAL. Require COURSE-01 implementation.

s3_proven_facts.fact: All draw and pace course claims require provenance fields
s3_proven_facts.label: VERIFIED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: No local draw or pace data exists. All public-guide claims = HYPOTHESIS_ONLY. Chester only at SECONDARY_HIGH_CONF.

s3_proven_facts.fact: Southwell surface was stale (Fibresand → Tapeta, changed 2021)
s3_proven_facts.label: CORRECTED_FACT
s3_proven_facts.detail: COURSE-00 had Southwell listed as Fibresand. Tapeta since 2021. Stale for 5 years. Now corrected.

s3_proven_facts.fact: Beverley is a drain course: 4.0% SR, pick avg SP 13.92 vs winner avg SP 7.21
s3_proven_facts.label: RESULT_PATTERN
s3_proven_facts.detail: 50 races. −6.7 SP gap. Root cause: draw bias + uphill finish + pace dynamics not captured.

s3_proven_facts.fact: AW cluster has combined 86 mid-price misses and no draw/pace modelling
s3_proven_facts.label: RESULT_PATTERN
s3_proven_facts.detail: Southwell, Kempton, Wolverhampton, Lingfield — all have draw/pace but VELO has none of it.

s4_decision_board.decision: COURSE-01 — Draw and Pace Shadow Feature Registry
s4_decision_board.purpose: Build shadow-only course eyes: draw bias, pace map, course-position per track/distance.
contract: Every feature must carry source_status + confidence + last_checked.
HYPOTHESIS features: shadow only, not promoted to scoring.
UNKNOWN-safe fallbacks mandatory.
Draw and pace must be LOCALLY CAPTURED before scoring use.
Provenance violation = feature blocked.

s4_decision_board.purpose: Repair price truth for EW ROI, value band, and exotics. Required before any profit claim on EW/exotics.
contract: Backfill pick_sp for all sigma rows where absent.
EW ROI cannot be claimed until prices are clean.
Exotics signal cannot be profit-proven without dividends.

s4_decision_board.purpose: Complete No-RPR GBM training (fold 2/3 was running). Evaluate vs legacy ensemble.
contract: No promotion without N≥300 prospective shadow rows.
Must not use --promote flag.
Operator gate required at fold completion.
s4_decision_board.blocked_by: VCP-03 gate + training corpus gap (76 audit dates absent Jan–May 2026)

s4_decision_board.gate: N≥300 prospective shadow rows + VCP-03 Day 10/10
s4_decision_board.purpose: Promote New Build from VALUE_SCOUT shadow to operational layer.
contract: NB is VALUE_SCOUT / EXOTIC_FILL_CANDIDATE — not replacement engine.
N=1125 ledger rows exist but need prospective shadow validation.
Must pass 300+ runners, 75+ top-decile prospective rows before operator review.
s4_decision_board.blocked_by: Insufficient prospective shadow n. VCP-03 gate.

s4_decision_board.purpose: Retrain on clean corpus once price truth and source truth are repaired.
contract: 76 audit dates absent from training corpus (Jan–May 2026).
pick_sp missing in most rows — EW/value training corrupted until VFU-21.
No training decisions before VFU-21 price truth repair.
s4_decision_board.blocked_by: Training corpus gap. Price truth gap. VCP-03 gate.
